touch.definition: CREATE TRIGGER touch AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF total ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch()

broken.definition: CREATE TRIGGER broken AFTER INSERT ON orders EXECUTE FUNCTION broken()

dynamic.definition: CREATE TRIGGER dynamic AFTER DELETE ON orders EXECUTE FUNCTION dynamic()

sql_touch.definition: CREATE TRIGGER sql_touch AFTER DELETE ON orders EXECUTE FUNCTION sql_touch()

conditional.definition: CREATE TRIGGER conditional AFTER INSERT ON orders FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.total > 0) EXECUTE FUNCTION touch()

unicode.definition: CREATE TRIGGER unicode AFTER INSERT ON orders EXECUTE FUNCTION unicode()

touch_again.definition: CREATE TRIGGER touch_again AFTER DELETE ON other_orders EXECUTE FUNCTION touch()

touch().definition: CREATE FUNCTION touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET BALANCE = balance + 1; INSERT INTO audit (id) VALUES (1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET count = 2; DELETE FROM expired; RETURN NEW; END; $$

broken().definition: CREATE FUNCTION broken() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET balance = 1; unsupported thing; RETURN NEW; END; $$

dynamic().definition: CREATE FUNCTION dynamic() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE accounts SET balance = 1'; RETURN NEW; END; $$

sql_touch().definition: CREATE FUNCTION sql_touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE accounts SET touched = true; $$

unicode().definition: CREATE FUNCTION unicode() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET balance = 1; 🦀 $$
